name: PARKOUR Reborn
desc:
PARKOUR Reborn is an open world platformer where you explore the city of Verna through the lens of a parkour runner. Learn new abilities, discover techniques, and craft gears to enhance your movement! Challenge yourself by racing your friends, completing precise time trials, and achieving high combos while freerunning!

PARKOUR Reborn is in paid early alpha access, but there are often temporary free periods after major updates where you can try out the game. It will become free upon its beta release, stay tuned!

Notice: Playing our game with any executor, injector, or modification to your Roblox client will result in a permanent ban.
